lina (DevEx): FYI onboarding hit a wall: samplekit publish blocked by a regendiff that bumped the generated package semver. cc @omar @mei
omar (Eng): ouch. what changed in the OpenAPI? any user-facing API change?
mei (SDK): looks like a harmless comment + snake_case -> camelCase key rename in examples. openapi.yaml had a tiny title tweak too. codegen reordered properties and typegen produced a changelog line, so semver moved from 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0. reproducer: `./dev/tools/regendiff packages/samplekit --base=main`
lina (DevEx): paste of regendiff:```
*** openapi.yaml
@@
-    description: "Example schema
-      // note: do not remove"
+    description: "Example schema
+      // note: preserved
+"
@@
-  - created_at
+  - createdAt
```
alex (PM): if the change is not functionally visible, we shouldn't force a release. can we strip doc/comment diffs out of the typegen changelog?
omear (note: typo)
omar (Eng): short-term plan: pin the generated pkg version in samplekit/package.json to 2.4.0 so the publish gate sees no drift. i'll open a PR to pin and add a CI lint step to fail early when regendiff is non-empty.
ci-bot: [publish] failure on refs/heads/onboard/samplekit 16: semver-check: published version mismatch detected (2.4.0 -> 2.5.0). see logs: `semver-guard: unexpected version change`
mei (SDK): long-term: change typegen to ignore whitespace/comment-only hunks before creating changelog entries. also make enum/property ordering deterministic (sort by name + original index) to avoid nondet reorders across platforms. will draft an RFC/PR.
lina (DevEx): thanks. i've created a small onboarding note and added a checklist item: "if regendiff shows only docs/formatting, pin generated artifact then follow-up with typegen fix".
alex (PM): please also add a short item to the release playbook about onboarding samplekit. we shouldn't surprise customers or new hires.
omear (again typo)
omar (Eng): PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/458 12 (pins 2.4.0 + regen-lint). merging after CI green.
mei (SDK): linking draft mitigation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/301 (strip-comment-hunks + deterministic-enum-sort). tests included.
lina (DevEx): Great. after merge i'll run the onboarding flow and confirm samplekit publishes. we should still add an automated check in the onboarding CI to catch semver drift earlier.
